name: anime-watcher
description: Aether-Ani: Neo-Tokyo Spatial Anime Streaming Platform powered by public anime APIs and Linux ani-cli engine

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); ['icon.png','icon.jpg','favicon.png','favicon.jpg','apple-touch-icon.png'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f); }); console.log('Vercel build complete');"

author: NARENDRA BORHADE <narendra.borhade@nmiet.edu.in>
